label.text: Drug Interactions No formal drug-drug interaction studies have been performed.

sections.contraindications: CONTRAINDICATIONS Ganirelix acetate is contraindicated under the following conditions: Known hypersensitivity to ganirelix acetate or to any of its components including dry natural rubber/latex (see HOW SUPPLIED ). Known hypersensitivity to GnRH or any other GnRH analog. Known or suspected pregnancy (see PRECAUTIONS ).
sections.pregnancy: Pregnancy Ganirelix acetate is contraindicated in pregnant women. When administered from Day 7 to near term to pregnant rats and rabbits at doses up to 10 and 30 mcg/day (approximately 0.4 to 3.2 times the human dose based on body surface area), ganirelix acetate increased the incidence of litter resorption. There was no increase in fetal abnormalities. No treatment-related changes in fertility, physical, or behavioral characteristics were observed in the offspring of female rats treated with ganirelix acetate during pregnancy and lactation. The effects on fetal resorption are logical consequences of the alteration in hormonal levels brought about by the antigonadotropic properties of this drug and could result in fetal loss in humans. Therefore, this drug should not be used in pregnant women (see CONTRAINDICATIONS ).
sections.nursing_mothers: Nursing Mothers Ganirelix acetate should not be used by lactating women. It is not known whether this drug is excreted in human milk.
sections.information_for_patients: Information for Patients Prior to therapy with ganirelix acetate, patients should be informed of the duration of treatment and monitoring procedures that will be required. The risk of possible adverse reactions should be discussed (see ADVERSE REACTIONS ). Ganirelix acetate should not be prescribed if the patient is pregnant.
